verses.en: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
verses.pt: SENHOR, escuta as minhas palavras; entende aquilo que estou meditando;
verses.en_web: Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker on wind instruments. A Psalm. Of David.> Give ear to my words, O Lord; give thought to my heart-searchings.

verses.en: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
verses.pt: Ouve a voz do meu clamor, meu Rei e meu Deus; porque a ti eu oro.
verses.en_web: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for to you do I pray.
verses.en_bbe: Let the voice of my cry come to you, my King and my God; for to you will I make my prayer.

verses.en: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
verses.pt: SENHOR, pela manhã ouvirás minha voz; pela manhã apresentarei meu clamor a ti, e ficarei esperando.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, in the morning you shall hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
verses.en_bbe: My voice will come to you in the morning, O Lord; in the morning will I send my prayer to you, and keep watch.

verses.en: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
verses.pt: Porque tu não és Deus que tens prazer na maldade; contigo não habitará o mau.
verses.en_web: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
verses.en_bbe: For you are not a God who takes pleasure in wrongdoing; there is no evil with you.

verses.en: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.pt: Os arrogantes não ficarão de pé diante dos teus olhos; tu odeias todas os praticantes de maldade.
verses.en_web: The arrogant shall not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of pride have no place before you; you are a hater of all workers of evil.

verses.en: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
verses.pt: Tu destruirás aos que falam mentiras; o SENHOR abomina ao homem sanguinário e enganador.
verses.en_web: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
verses.en_bbe: You will send destruction on those whose words are false; the cruel man and the man of deceit are hated by the Lord.

verses.en: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
verses.pt: Mas eu, pela grandeza de tua bondade, entrarei em tua casa; adorarei inclinado para o templo de tua santidade em temor a ti.
verses.en_web: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
verses.en_bbe: But as for me, I will come into your house, in the full measure of your mercy; and in your fear I will give worship, turning my eyes to your holy Temple.

verses.en: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
verses.pt: SENHOR, guia-me em tua justiça, por causa dos meus adversários; prepara diante de mim o teu caminho.
verses.en_web: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
verses.en_bbe: Be my guide, O Lord, in the ways of your righteousness, because of those who are against me; make your way straight before my face.

verses.en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.pt: Porque não há verdade na boca deles; seu interior são meras destruições; a garganta deles é uma sepultura aberta; com suas línguas elogiam falsamente.
verses.en_web: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.
verses.en_bbe: For no faith may be put in their words; their inner part is nothing but evil; their throat is like an open place for the dead; smooth are the words of their tongues.

verses.en: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
verses.pt: Declara-os culpados, ó Deus, e que caiam de seus próprios conselhos; expulsa-os por causa da abundância de suas transgressões, porque eles se rebelaram contra ti.
verses.en_web: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels; Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
verses.en_bbe: Send them to destruction, O Lord; let their evil designs be the cause of their fall; let them be forced out by all their sins; because they have gone against your authority.

verses.en: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
verses.pt: Mas se alegrem todos os que confiam em ti; clamai de alegria para sempre; porque tu os proteges; e fiquem contentes em ti aqueles que amam o teu nome.
verses.en_web: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice, Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
verses.en_bbe: But let all those who put their faith in you be glad with cries of joy at all times, and let all the lovers of your name be glad in you.

verses.en: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
verses.pt: Porque tu, SENHOR, abençoarás ao justo; como com um escudo tu o rodearás com tua bondade. Salmo de Davi para o regente, com instrumentos de cordas, uma harpa de oito cordas:
verses.en_web: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
verses.en_bbe: For you, Lord, will send a blessing on the upright man; your grace will be round him, and you will be his strength.
